patch_resolves_note: The staged patch updates the local-header extra-field parse call from `parseExtraField(buffer, handledextralen, true, pfi)` to `parseExtraField(buffer, n, true, pfi)`, so the fixed original still executes the parser call but no longer overstates the initialized extent of `buffer` after a short read.

nodes.description: At the `if (fieldsize > size)` sink, the 4-byte local scalar `fieldsize` is still underinitialized because the parser has advanced into the unread tail of `KZip::openArchive`'s stack buffer.

edges.description: The same stack buffer base pointer passed from `KZip::openArchive` into `parseExtraField` is the parser input whose later `fieldsize` load reaches the sink.

root_cause_criterion.description: Before `parseExtraField` is called on the extra-field buffer, the byte count handed to the parser must not exceed the actual byte count `n` returned by `dev->read(buffer, handledextralen)`.
